notes:
BETA build - for testing.
- Fix: while a repeating macro was held (above all in a game), the whole keyboard could stop responding for a while - even after the app was closed. The keyboard no longer has to wait for the app when you press a trigger key, and a repeated macro can no longer flood Windows with key presses (one cycle now takes at least 10 ms).
- Keys that a macro is holding down are released when the app is closed in the middle of the macro.
